paragraphs.text: Arlen was a sorcerer of the Institute of Arcane Study on Dominaria .

He traveled with his horse Feathers to the land of Kush on Aerona to discover the reason for the Festival of Estark and the reasons for the powerful mages that came from Kush. He was kicked out when he visited the town of Farndrel . As he rested outside the village, he fell asleep and was killed by Leshrac Nightwalker , who was able to manifest on Dominaria despite being trapped in Phyrexia .
